name: Transaction Data 3
definition: Transaction Data related to an order.

TransactionPrice.name: Transaction Price
TransactionPrice.definition: Traded price of the transaction excluding, where applicable, commission and accrued interest.

TradedQuantity.name: Traded Quantity
TradedQuantity.definition: Quantity being executed, when there is a partial or full execution.

PassiveOrAggressiveIndicator.name: Passive Or Aggressive Indicator
PassiveOrAggressiveIndicator.definition: Indicates whether order provided or took liquidity, on partial fill or fill order events.

StrategyLinkedOrderIdentification.name: Strategy Linked Order Identification
StrategyLinkedOrderIdentification.definition: Alphanumerical code used to link all connected orders that are part of a strategy.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Alphanumerical code assigned by the trading venue to the transaction.

OneElementPresenceRule.definition: TransactionPrice must be present or |TradedQuantity must be present or |PassiveOrAggressiveIndicator must be present or |StrategyLinkedOrderIdentification must be present or |TransactionIdentification must be present.
